name: Mandate 23
definition: Information that serves as a basis to debit an account.

MandateIdentification.name: Mandate Identification
MandateIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the responsible party (such as the creditor) or agent (such as the debtor agent), to unambiguously identify the mandate.

MandateRequestIdentification.name: Mandate Request Identification
MandateRequestIdentification.definition: Identification for the mandate request, as assigned by the initiating party.

Authentication.name: Authentication
Authentication.definition: Specifies the transport authentication details related to the mandate.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of mandate, such as paper, electronic or scheme.

Occurrences.name: Occurrences
Occurrences.definition: Provides details of the duration of the mandate and occurrence of the underlying transactions.

TrackingIndicator.name: Tracking Indicator
TrackingIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the direct debit instructions should be automatically re-submitted periodically when bilaterally agreed.

FirstCollectionAmount.name: First Collection Amount
FirstCollectionAmount.definition: Amount different from the collection amount, as it includes the costs associated with the first debited amount.

CollectionAmount.name: Collection Amount
CollectionAmount.definition: Fixed amount to be collected from the debtor's account.

MaximumAmount.name: Maximum Amount
MaximumAmount.definition: Maximum amount that may be collected from the debtor's account, per instruction.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Specifies the characteristics of the adjustment applied to the collection amount of a direct debit instruction.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Provides the reason for the setup of the mandate.

CreditorSchemeIdentification.name: Creditor Scheme Identification
CreditorSchemeIdentification.definition: Credit party that signs the mandate.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party that signs the mandate and to whom an amount of money is due.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

UltimateCreditor.name: Ultimate Creditor
UltimateCreditor.definition: Ultimate party to which an amount of money is due.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party that signs the mandate and owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor, to which a debit entry will be made as a result of the transaction.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.

UltimateDebtor.name: Ultimate Debtor
UltimateDebtor.definition: Ultimate party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

MandateReference.name: Mandate Reference
MandateReference.definition: Reference assigned by a creditor or ultimate creditor for internal usage for the mandate.

ReferredDocument.name: Referred Document
ReferredDocument.definition: Provides information to identify the underlying documents associated with the mandate.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements within the message component.

UltimateDebtorGuideline.definition: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

UltimateCreditorGuideline.definition: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.
